subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Interpretar, em textos lidos ou de produção própria, efeitos de sentido de modificadores do verbo (adjuntos adverbiais – advérbios e expressões adverbiais), usando-os para enriquecer seus próprios textos.

components.description_pt: Identificar adjuntos adverbiais — advérbios e locuções adverbiais — funcionando como modificadores verbais em textos
components.description_en: Identify adverbial adjuncts — adverbs and adverbial phrases — functioning as verb modifiers in texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in a given sentence

components.description_pt: Interpretar efeitos de sentido produzidos por adjuntos adverbiais em textos lidos
components.description_en: Interpret meaning effects produced by adverbial adjuncts in read texts

components.description_pt: Aplicar adjuntos adverbiais para enriquecer e adicionar precisão à própria escrita
components.description_en: Apply adverbial adjuncts to enrich and add precision to one's own writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply transitions to clarify how concepts in discipline-specific writing connect to one another

cc_matches.description: Explain the function of nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in general and their functions in particular sentences.
Use appropriate and varied transitions to create cohesion and clarify the relationships among ideas and concepts.
